 print(json.dumps({'health':{'iowait_percent':wait,'samples':samples},'paused':True}));raise SystemExit(0)

  m=re.fullmatch(r'archive\.(\d+)\.pack',p.name)

   magic=f.read(4);assert magic==struct.pack('<I',0xae8fdd01)
